Content settings control paragraph lines, list markers, emphasis, tables, and inline heading images

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try crawlberg.scrape("{\"content\":{\"bullets\":\"*\",\"compact_tables\":true,\"extract_metadata\":false,\"keep_inline_images_in\":[\"h2\"],\"list_indent_width\":4,\"strip_newlines\":true,\"strong_em_symbol\":\"_\"}}", "https://example.com");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
